title: Homogeneous Catalyst Ligand Poisoning & Recovery Metallurgy
description: Upper-intermediate chemical API synthesis module analyzing homogeneous catalyst ligand poisoning & recovery metallurgy.
learning_objectives: Master professional Nominalization in Process Chemistry in organic API synthesis and QC analysis
Eliminate common Czech interference errors in homogeneous catalyst ligand poisoning & recovery metallurgy
Demonstrate precision in HPLC, Karl Fischer, and pharmacopeial compliance documentation

questions.prompt: The pharmacopeial monograph requires that the chromatographic peak resolution between API and impurity A _____ not less than 2.0.

explanations.correct: B2 analytical & organic chemistry syntax: Mandative subjunctive after 'requires that' takes base form 'be'.
explanations.wrong_A: Option 'is' violates formal mandative subjunctive or inversion rules.
explanations.wrong_C: Option 'will be' applies inappropriate indicative or non-inverted phrasing.
explanations.wrong_D: Option 'must to be' is ungrammatical in formal scientific chemistry discourse.

questions.cz_learning_point: Advanced analytical chemistry reporting demands strict mandative subjunctive ('mandates that it be concluded') and auxiliary inversion ('Rarely does a method pass').

questions.prompt: Under no circumstances _____ discard the original chromatographic raw data files without prior QA authorization.

explanations.wrong_B: Option 'analysts must to' applies inappropriate indicative or non-inverted phrasing.
explanations.wrong_D: Option 'shall analysts to' is ungrammatical in formal scientific chemistry discourse.
